question: Will 'Inside Out 2' gross most in 2024?
vault_gap: Entertainment/box office coverage completely absent from vault. The blind summaries cover sports (Euro, Copa America, T20 World Cup) but zero film/box office data.
rationale: Inside Out 2 was released June 14, 2024. By the July 15 cutoff, it had already grossed over $1B worldwide — making it the fastest animated film to reach $1B. Joker 2 (the only plausible competitor for 'most gross in 2024') wasn't released until October. Inside Out 2 ended the year as the highest-grossing film.
